title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 1: the genealogy from Adam through Noah's sons, Abraham, Ishmael, Esau and the kings of Edom.

questions.text: Which names close the list in verse 4, right after Noah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:4 lists Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

questions.text: Cush became the father of which man, who began to be a mighty one in the earth?
questions.explanation: Cush became the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one in the earth.

questions.text: According to verse 12, from which of Mizraim's descendants did the Philistines come?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 names the Casluhim and adds that the Philistines came from them.
Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of Heth.

questions.text: Why was one of Eber's sons named Peleg?
questions.explanation: To Eber were born two sons; one was named Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided.

answers.text: In his days the earth was divided
His mother bore him with sorrow

questions.text: Who was the firstborn of Ishmael?
questions.explanation: The firstborn of Ishmael was Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel and Mibsam.
Verse 32 speaks of the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine, who bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.

questions.text: Who are named as the sons of Isaac?
questions.explanation: Abraham became the father of Isaac, and the sons of Isaac were Esau and Israel.

questions.text: What was the name of the city of Bela the son of Beor, the first king listed in Edom?
questions.explanation: Among the kings who reigned in Edom before any king reigned over Israel was Bela the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

questions.text: Whom did Hadad the son of Bedad strike in the field of Moab?
questions.explanation: Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in Husham's place.
